newsitem.title: GREECE: GREECE'S SFAKIANAKIS SETS IPO PRICE AT 2,000 DRS.
newsitem.headline: GREECE'S SFAKIANAKIS SETS IPO PRICE AT 2,000 DRS.

text.p: Greek automobile dealer Sfakianakis AEBE said it would go public at 2,000 drachmas a share and be listed on the Athens bourse's main market.
Subscriptions to its initial public offering will run from May 27-30, it said.

Sfakianakis will tap the market for 4.25 billion drachmas with an issue of 2,125,000 common bearer shares with a par value of 300 drachmas. It said 100,000 shares will be privately placed, leaving 2,025,000 for the public offering.

Issue advisor is N. Devletoglou Securities. Lead underwriter is Alpha Credit Bank joined by co-underwiters Credit Lyonnais Securities, National Bank, Eurobank, Piraeus Bank, Commercial Bank, Ergobank and Xiosbank.
Other co-underwiters include General Bank, Bank of Athens, Alpha Finance, Intersec, European Popular Bank, Telesis Securities and Alpha Brokerage.
IPO proceeds will be used as working capital and will finance the completion of new facilities.
Sfakianakis is a fast growing auto dealer and ranked first place in terms of profitability in 1995 in its sector, it said.
In 1996 pretax earnings grew 58 percent to 3.78 billion drachmas on turnover growth of 31 percent -- 32.6 billion. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
